86 engagements

Land and districts create value when the use, the capital and the vehicle are designed together.

Real estate and urban development account for 86 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. The record runs from single plots to whole districts: a mixed-use development in central Makkah, the regeneration of downtown Jeddah and seven informal areas in Makkah. We test the use, model the economics, design the capital stack and the vehicle, and stay through delivery.

Archive census counts are indicative.

What we do

  • Market research and highest-and-best-use studies for land and buildings.

  • Feasibility studies, financial models and valuation reports.

  • Land assembly through in-kind contributions, so landowners join the project as equity partners.

  • District regeneration and redevelopment programs.

  • SPV, joint-venture and real-estate fund structures. Any fund is set up and managed by a CMA-authorised manager.

  • Bank processes and Sukuk readiness for income-producing assets.

  • Board representation on real-estate funds, as a governance role.

How we create value

  • 02

    Monetization

    In Makkah we advised on the redevelopment of seven informal areas, about 3.67m m² in total, under an agreement signed in October 2024.

  • 03

    Optimization

    In central Makkah, the feasibility study, financial models and information memorandum tested a 151,000 m² mixed-use project in which landowners’ land formed part of the capital.

  • 06

    Commercialization

    For downtown Jeddah, the financial model and investor presentation took 197,391 m² of assembled public, private and reclaimed land to investors.

Questions

What is a highest-and-best-use study?

A study that compares the uses a site or building could be put to and identifies the one that is legally permitted, physically possible, financially viable and gives the asset its highest value.

Why are some project values shown as a range?

Some projects were recorded at different values in different documents. Until the documents are reconciled, the site shows the range, or no figure at all.

What does “HAYKALAH scope delivered” mean?

That HAYKALAH completed its part of the work, such as the model and the investor presentation. It does not mean that the project was built.

Tell us about the land, the building or the district. We can start under an NDA.
